issues: only 4/5 incorrect sources are counted WA algorithmic kills

submissions.reason: Limits split lengths with the wrong window (min(5,n-1)); misses 1000000+1000000+1000000.
Uses break instead of continue on leading-zero and >1e6 parts, so it skips valid later splits.
A debug print(g) echoes the input before the answer, so the WA on 0001 is a formatting artifact, not an algorithmic defect.
Splits the integer from the right and never rejects leading zeros or parts that are empty after integer conversion.
Accepts parts with leading zeros through int() and only special-cases a "000" prefix; 0009 prints 9 instead of -1.
The degree comparison has duplicated branches (n>m twice, m<n is unreachable), so n<m prints a fraction instead of 0/1.
Prints p0/q0 without normalizing the sign or reducing by gcd when p0%q0!=0 (2/4 instead of 1/2).
Prints "0" instead of "0/1" when the denominator degree is larger.
Ignores the leading-coefficient signs when the limit is infinite, so it prints Infinity instead of -Infinity.
Adds a "-" prefix from b*c<0 but keeps the signed values, so 9/-5 prints -9/-5 instead of -9/5.
